Note: Re-test 2026-10-16 on 25acd727 (640bc7c4): the dashboard opens on Today's Visits and counts only In Today residents; TC-20/S04a, S07, S02, S23 and TC-09/S09 pass locally. Also fixed on dev (2026-10-16 19:18–19:45 JST: TC-20/S04a, S04b, S06, S07, S23, TC-09/S09; unit U69 passes).

Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S04a Nursing Home: In Today yes/no decides who is counted (TFA-92587 AC 6)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U5 Nursing Home counts are based on the residents marked 'In Today'. Marking a resident adds them to the counts. Un-marking removes them from today's counts without deleting them from All Residents (UAT TC-09; TFA-92598 AC 4; TFA-92587 AC 6; TFA-92587 AC 2)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Seeded Nursing Home census of 7 residents: 5 marked In Today (2 pending, 1 pre-rounded, 1 in-encounter, 1 complete) and 2 not in today (1 pending, 1 complete). One In Today, pending resident on a second @roundai.test account. Plus the standard Hospital patient

When Open the Nursing Home list on Today's Visits, then open the dashboard from the bottom nav

Then Today's Visits lists the 5 In Today residents and not the other 2. The dashboard's Total is 5: the 2 residents who are not in today and the other physician's In Today resident are not counted

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Decision table on In Today yes/no: a resident is counted only when yes (TFA-92587 AC 6, TFA-92598 AC 4, UAT TC-09), and never another physician's resident. Checkpoint 1: mustContain N1–N5; mustNotContain N6, N7, the foreign resident and the Hospital patient. Checkpoint 2: counts Total 5 only; mustNotContain the foreign resident and the Hospital patient. …

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S04a is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-20.matrix.json; a letter suffix = one case split in several), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; the bug was fixed on 25acd727 and this re-test passes, so its status is kept (the rows below are about the older build).

Issue type: Known product issue · environment dev + local · tickets TFA-92587 ready for qa; TFA-92598 ready for qa

The Nursing Home dashboard counts every resident (22) instead of only the 19 marked In Today, so the physician's totals include residents who are not being seen today.

Evidence: allure-results/6c897174…: NH dashboard Total 22 (7/9/6) vs 19 residents In Today; dev/datasets and local datasets give the same result. Recorded: dev report §4 known gap (U57/U69/U56), TFA-92587 AC 6 / TFA-92598 AC 4; matrix U5 says it is ungated against 92587 AC 6.

Folded in: TC-20/S04a local datasets (same failure, merged into this row)

Duplicates (the same issue, read here): TC-20/S06, TC-20/S07
